      Care reminders

      Watering and fertilizing reminders live only in a local file on this device (var/reminders.json) — nothing is uploaded. They do not sync across devices, and there is no push or notification delivery: you have to open the app to see what's due. A reminder's cadence is your own setting, not a cited fact.
